description:
A thought-provoking & inspiring Joint Club Speaker Meet @ YBChavan, hosted by Rotary Club of Queens Necklace with Rotary Clubs of Bombay North, Bombay Pier, Hanging Gardens, Bombay Metropolitan, Bombay Bayview as co-hosts, featured Mr. Tukaram Mundhe, Commissioner, Food & Drug Administration. Speaking on “Why Me? – From Why Me to Why Can’t I”, Mr. Mundhe shared his remarkable journey from humble beginnings to securing 20th rank in the UPSC, highlighting resilience, self-belief and integrity.

His message was powerful: While “Why me?” is a natural response to adversity, we must move beyond it and ask, “Why can’t I?” Why can’t I dream, compete, seek justice and make a difference?

He emphasised that true poverty can also be a poverty of ideas, values and ethics. He spoke passionately about honesty in public service, food and drug safety, and the importance of supporting ethical, compliant businesses.

His call to action: ASK. READ. REPORT.

An enriching evening that inspired 25 Pierites
